text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The privatisation of Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) this year will result in increased activity on the Lusaka stock exchange, finance deputy minister Godfrey Simasiku said.
- Norway has advised the government to invest heavily in technology if it is to compete economically with other countries.
- Nine people from the same family died after being struck by lightning in southern Zambia.
- The mining town of Maamba, which suffered water and power cuts in floods last week, could experience an epidemic unless normal supplies are restored soon, government officials said.
- The Southern African Development Community (SADC) will not allow its members to belong indefinitely to the Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA), a SADC official said.
- The ministry of agriculture will cut 3,000 jobs in a restructuring exercise this year, a ministry official said.
